title: German Sausage Pasta
description: A hearty German-inspired pasta dish featuring sausage and vegetables.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Jamaican sausage to the skillet and cook until browned.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the canned tomato to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the sausage and vegetable mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
